title: Olive Garden Gnocchi Toscana Soup
description: A rich copycat recipe of the Olive Garden favorite, with chicken, Italian sausage, pillowy gnocchi, and fresh kale in a creamy parmesan broth.
author: Jackie
instructions: In a large pot, brown Italian sausage over medium-high heat for 6 minutes. Remove with slotted spoon.
In same pot, melt butter. Sauté diced celery, onions, and shredded carrots for 3 minutes until softened. Stir in minced garlic and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add cooked diced chicken, chicken broth, thyme, salt, and pepper. Bring to a rolling boil.
Add potato gnocchi and boil gently for 4 minutes until gnocchi float to the surface.
Lower heat to a gentle simmer. Stir in chopped kale, heavy cream, and cooked sausage.
Simmer for 5 minutes until kale is wilted and soup is velvety.
Serve warm topped with freshly grated parmesan cheese.
tips: For extra depth of flavor, simmer a parmesan cheese rind in the broth along with the chicken.

title: Cava Chicken & Hummus Bowl
description: Copycat Cava Mediterranean grain bowl layered with spiced grilled chicken, creamy garlic hummus, tomato-cucumber salad, pickled onions, and garlic dressing.
author: Brandon

ingredients.item: chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
cooked saffron basmati rice or brown rice
olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, garlic powder

instructions: Marinate chicken pieces in olive oil, lemon juice, dried oregano, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper for 15 minutes.
Sear chicken in a screaming-hot skillet or grill pan for 6-8 minutes until golden and charred on the edges.
Toss diced cucumbers and cherry tomatoes with olive oil, salt, and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.
Assemble bowls: scoop warm basmati rice into base.
Top with generous scoops of garlic hummus and cucumber-tomato salad.
Add charred chicken, pickled red onions, crumbled feta cheese, and drizzle with Tzatziki dressing.
Serve with warm pita wedges.
tips: Make quick pickled red onions by soaking sliced red onion in warm white vinegar, water, sugar, and salt for 15 minutes.

title: Chipotle Chicken Burrito Bowl
description: Copycat Chipotle burrito bowl with adobo-marinated grilled chicken, cilantro-lime white rice, black beans, fresh pico de gallo, and guacamole.
author: Brandon

ingredients.item: shredded Monterey Jack or cheddar cheese

instructions: Puree chipotle peppers with adobo sauce, minced garlic, 2 tbsp lime juice, cumin, and olive oil.
Coat chicken thighs in chipotle marinade. Let sit 15 minutes.
Sear chicken in a hot cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes per side until charred and cooked through (internal temp 165°F). Rest 5 minutes, then dice into cubes.
Toss warm cooked white rice with remaining 1 tbsp lime juice, chopped cilantro, and salt.
Assemble bowls: base of cilantro-lime rice, black beans, and diced chipotle chicken.
Top with shredded cheese, sour cream, pico de gallo, and a generous scoop of guacamole.
tips: Using chicken thighs instead of breasts guarantees the juicy, charred flavor signature to Chipotle's chicken.

title: Olive Garden Zuppa Toscana
description: Copycat Olive Garden rustic soup packed with spicy Italian sausage, tender sliced russet potatoes, and hearty fresh kale in a rich creamy broth with bacon.
author: Brandon
cookware: Large Dutch Oven or Soup Pot

ingredients.item: russet potatoes, sliced into ¼-inch half-moons
fresh curly kale, stemmed and chopped
red pepper flakes and black pepper

instructions: In a large Dutch oven, fry diced bacon over medium heat until crispy. Transfer bacon with slotted spoon to paper towels, leaving drippings in pot.
Add Italian sausage to the bacon fat, breaking it into bite-sized pieces until browned (about 6 minutes). Drain excess grease if desired.
Add diced onion and cook for 4 minutes until translucent. Stir in minced garlic and red pepper flakes; cook for 1 minute.
Pour in chicken broth and add the sliced russet potatoes. Bring to a rolling boil.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer uncovered for 15-20 minutes, until potatoes are fork-tender.
Stir in chopped kale and heavy cream. Simmer for an additional 4 minutes until kale is wilted.
Ladle into bowls, top with crispy reserved bacon and freshly grated parmesan cheese.
tips: Russet potatoes naturally break down slightly around the edges, thickening the broth into that velvety restaurant consistency.

title: Creamy Tuscan Sausage & Kale Soup
description: Hearty, comforting Italian country soup loaded with sweet Italian sausage, red potatoes, white cannellini beans, and garden kale.
author: Brandon
instructions: Brown sausage and onion in a large pot over medium-high heat until sausage is cooked through.
Add quartered red potatoes and chicken stock. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes until potatoes are soft.
Add cannellini beans and chopped kale. Simmer for 3 minutes.
Stir in cream and grated parmesan cheese. Season with salt and cracked pepper.
Serve warm with crusty garlic bread.
tips: Cannellini beans add extra protein and a creamy texture to the broth.
